scientific_question: Can explicit chemical and nuisance structure reduce acquisition-domain information and cross-instrument replicate distance without erasing analyte information, repeatable peaks, or reconstruction fidelity?

claim_vocabulary.structured: The architecture or objectives assign different roles to latent partitions.
claim_vocabulary.nuisance_suppressed: The chemical partition passes registered nuisance-reduction and chemical-preservation gates.
claim_vocabulary.disentangled: Nuisance-suppressed plus convergent partition-specific probes, dependence diagnostics, real-pair swaps, negative controls, and unseen-domain confirmation.
claim_vocabulary.unsuccessful: No registered candidate passes the required gates.

frozen_backbone.epoch_schedule: four fixed 25-epoch beta cycles during epochs 1-100, then beta=0.25 through epoch 500

leakage_boundary.minimal_sensitivity: selected arpls candidate only and cannot alter selection
locked_until_selection_closes: grouped outer strict and quality outcomes

stage_0_identity.requirement: Invoke the exact frozen adequacy model, objective, seeds, folds, optimizer arithmetic and checkpoints; histories must agree within 1e-12 and checkpoint tensors exactly.
stage_0_identity.failure_action: Stop structured selection and repair implementation.

partition_controls.conditioning: instrument and sensor one-hot with unknown all-zero inference state

mechanism_search.fixed_base: best eligible partition control by registered hierarchy
mechanism_search.adversary: target-conditioned domain classifier, analyte-domain cell-balanced cross entropy, gradient reversal ramped linearly from epochs 101-200 and fixed thereafter
mechanism_search.same_master_loss: one minus cosine similarity between chemical posterior means for deterministic real cross-instrument partners
mechanism_search.cross_reconstruction: decode source chemical plus partner nuisance/conditioning and compare only with the real same-master partner spectrum
mechanism_search.dependence_loss: squared Frobenius norm of standardized chemical-nuisance cross-covariance

opening_rules.sensor_adversary: opens only after an instrument-adversarial candidate preserves chemistry and improves the instrument probe
opening_rules.dependence: opens only when the selected partition has mean maximum canonical correlation above 0.50
opening_rules.combination: combine only individually eligible mechanisms with compatible directional gains

negative_controls.nuisance_permutation: permute instrument and sensor labels within analyte strata and inner-training partition
negative_controls.pair_permutation: permute partner master IDs within analyte strata while retaining the pair-count distribution
negative_controls.chemical_permutation: permute analyte labels across master_sample_id groups
negative_controls.execution: run on the frozen structured candidate after inner selection and before locked confirmation

expectations.nuisance_permutation: removes genuine domain-head and adversarial benefit

hierarchy: Pareto nondominated for chemical accuracy, instrument probe, same-master distance, correlation and peak recall

required_metrics: chemical and nuisance balanced accuracy and macro F1
target-adjusted cell-balanced instrument and sensor probes for each partition and union
cross-covariance and maximum canonical correlation between partitions
KL, active units and posterior sampling variability per partition
MSE, Smooth L1, spectral angle, derivative error and median row correlation
repeatable-peak recall, shift, width and prominence
corruption classification agreement, reconstruction recovery and latent drift
real-pair consistency, cross-reconstruction and swap metrics
terminal_decision: Classify the final evidence as disentangled, nuisance-suppressed, structured-only, or unsuccessful; freeze the model for downstream work only if its registered claim level is supported.
